decision_conditions: proposed works to fabric of LB. Please  withdraw this application and submit variation applications.
description: Comprehensive refurbishment of the existing building, including internal and external reconfiguration and restoration works; demolition of existing attached garage structure and replacement with a single storey side extension; new single storey garage structure in front garden; new lap pool and pool house to the rear garden; and restoration of gardens (including tree works) and driveway. [Non-material amendment to planning reference PA25/0848 to allow for Reduction in the size of the consented extension; Retention of existing rooflight; Retention of the existing external stairs at the western end of Strawberry House, with the adjacent external door replaced by a new timber door to match the existing; Alteration to the pitch of the consented extension roof, with an overall height reduction compared to the consented proposals. The roof finish is revised from fish-scale tiles to standing seam zinc. Internal works comprise: Introduction of vaulted ceiling to the studio at first floor; Revision to the second-floor layout, with bathroom and study rooms swapped; Revision to the second-floor layout, with the bathroom and study rooms swapped; and Omission of the double-height library to the western end of Strawberry House.]
